newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse completes purchase of Lucent unit.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse completes purchase of Lucent unit.

text.p: Private investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc said on Monday it completed the previously announced acquisition of Lucent Technologies Inc's interconnection business for undisclosed terms.
The business makes printed circuit boards and backplanes, Hicks said. In September, a Lucent spokesman said the division had revenues in the "hundreds of millions of dollars."

The acquired unit has been renamed Circo Craft Technologies Inc and would operate as a wholly owned unit of the newly formed holding company Circo Technologies Group Inc. It is located in Richmond, Va., Hicks said.
